verdict.rationale: Asana's REST API reference documents a built-in, in-context API explorer on every endpoint that lets users make requests and see responses, which directly delivers an interactive reference with runnable calls. A developer sandbox domain gives a safe place to run them. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the explorer works as described, evidence of per-language runnable code samples in the reference

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Each API endpoint features a built-in, in-context API explorer through which you can make requests (and see responses).
The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON or form-encoded requests, returns JSON
A developer sandbox is a temporary Asana domain with limited users.
